title: REQ · Phaser BootScene creates scene effects from content and cleans them up
summary: A Phaser-backed effect context is used by BootScene to create dust, light and fade from scene content
description: Implement EffectRenderContext on Phaser (particles for dust, tinted rectangle for light, camera fade) and call buildEffects in BootScene.create, destroying handles on shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create, when scene content has effects, then buildEffects is called with the Phaser context and the scene content
Given SHUTDOWN, when it fires, then every effect handle is destroyed
Given the Phaser context playTransition(400), when called, then cameras.main.fadeIn(400) is invoked
